content: Now we extend the stacked LSTM formulation defined above to address the problem noted in the previous subsection. To enhance the interaction between layers in a way similar to how LSTMs keep and forget the information from the previous time step, we introduce the additional forget gate INLINEFORM0 that determines whether to accept or ignore the signals coming from the previous layer. Therefore the proposed Cell-aware Stacked LSTM is formulated as follows: DISPLAYFORM0 DISPLAYFORM1
